_comment: League identity for the current season. League IDs roll over each season: re-resolve via GET https://api.sleeper.app/v1/user/{userId}/leagues/nfl/{season} and update this file. Scoring adjustment flags (TE premium, 4pt pass TD) are derived live from each league's scoring_settings at refresh time; set an override here only to force a flag on or off.

leagues.label: The Syndicate
leagues._comment: Yardage-bonus league: volumeBonus cannot be derived from scoring_settings flags alone, so it is forced on here.
